children: When you use the site without signing in, your done and planned marks, favorites, and personal notes are stored in this browser's local storage. Clearing browser data may remove them.

If you create an account and sign in, we store the name and email you provide, data needed for login, and the entry statuses, favorites, notes, and update times synced to your account. A cookie keeps your login session active. You can export your checklist as a CSV file.

When you create an account, we record the IP address and browser language of the sign-up request. Each sign-in session stores the IP address and browser identifier (user agent). We use these only for account security, abuse prevention and troubleshooting. They are kept with the account or session and deleted with the account. To prevent automated abuse, some actions are rate-limited per account or per browser: the site stores a randomly generated identifier cookie (hlb_bid, valid for one year, containing no personal information) in your browser. The server keeps only a one-way hash of it or of your account, for at most one day. When you sign in with WeChat, the verification code and a random account or browser identifier are sent to the site operator's WeChat verification service to confirm your identity and limit attempts. Your IP address is not sent.

The site is delivered through the Cloudflare network and hosted by Vercel, and Zeabur hosts the account database. These providers may process technical request information to deliver and protect the service. This site currently has no paid checkout.

props.className: text-foreground mt-6 mb-2 text-lg font-semibold tracking-tight md:text-xl

children: We use this information to provide reading, checklist storage, cross-device sync, account access, and necessary security maintenance. We do not sell your personal checklist or email address.

props.className: text-foreground mt-6 mb-2 text-lg font-semibold tracking-tight md:text-xl

children: We use Google Analytics to understand page visits, reading, checklist actions and sharing tools. Google may use cookies and process device and visit information. Our custom events contain coarse action types, language and success or failure. They do not include names, email addresses, notes, search text, edited sharing captions, individual suggestion choices or checklist snapshots. Page addresses sent by our tracking code exclude query strings and anchors. Local development and preview deployments do not send these events.

You may block analytics through your browser or a content blocker; the reading and checklist features remain available. Sharing images are generated on your device. Copying or downloading does not publish them; sending them to a social platform is your choice.

children: Without signing in, drawn tasks and check-in dates stay in this browser. When signed in, new task selections, dates and completion timestamps are saved to your account. Older local records stay in your browser and are not automatically uploaded or counted on the leaderboard. Days follow your device's time zone: your browser sends the time zone name (for example, America/New_York) with each request. It is used only to work out the current date and is not stored.

Joining the leaderboard is optional. It shows only the separate nickname you provide and your day counts (total, current streak and this month), never your email, task details or daily history. Leaving removes your nickname and score from the leaderboard while keeping your personal records. You can undo today's check-in. Contact support to request deletion of all server-side check-in records.

A shared daily-task link contains only a public task identifier. A share image may include your selected task, completion status and the day's date; review it before sending. Analytics for daily tasks record only coarse actions such as draw, complete, undo, join and leave, never nicknames, task contents or check-in history.

props.className: text-foreground mt-6 mb-2 text-lg font-semibold tracking-tight md:text-xl

children: We use Google AdSense for non-personalized ads. Ad scripts load on eligible public content pages only when advertising is enabled. These ads do not use your browsing history or personal checklist to build an interest profile. Google and its advertising partners may still use cookies, web beacons, IP addresses, and device or browser identifiers for ad delivery, frequency capping, aggregate measurement, fraud prevention and security. Google and its advertising partners may receive and process this information.

We use the hosting platform’s country signal to decide whether to show a first-visit prompt, not the interface language; we do not retain your IP address, city or precise location for this decision. First visits in the EEA, UK and Switzerland show a choice prompt; an unknown location also shows a prompt. Elsewhere, non-personalized advertising and visit statistics generally start enabled and can be disabled anytime; a browser Global Privacy Control signal prevents automatic enabling. Regional defaults are not stored as consent. The location result (only whether a prompt is needed) is cached in this browser for up to 24 hours and refreshed in the background on each page load; if the location check fails or times out, the browser’s time zone decides: European time zones show the prompt, others start enabled. Declining these optional services does not affect reading, checklists or sign-in. Use Privacy settings at the bottom of any page to change or withdraw your choices. Changing a saved choice reloads the page to stop previously loaded optional scripts. Your choices and their timestamp stay in this browser for 180 days. Clearing browser data or changing devices requires a new choice.

We do not use personal notes, individual checklist choices, health information, sexual orientation or financial hardship for ad targeting, or intentionally send names, email addresses or account identifiers to advertising services. Google Analytics follows your statistics settings and has ad personalization signals disabled.

When usage analytics is enabled, we also count submitted checkup choices and entry opens, done, planned, favorite and removal actions on this site, grouped by day and source page. These requests omit login cookies. The counter table stores no accounts, visitor identifiers, IP addresses, notes or individual questionnaires, and these choices and entry data are not sent to Google Analytics or advertising services. Retakes and repeated actions count again: totals measure submissions and actions, not unique people.

children: Answering together verifies participants through their signed-in accounts. Nicknames and answers are encrypted by the server and saved in the database, not stored locally in your browser. You can continue on another device using the same account. Content has no expiration date and is kept until any participant deletes the entire conversation. For each question, only participants who have submitted that question can see answers from others who have submitted it. Unsubmitted drafts are not returned to other participants. The invitation link can be used to join this conversation; send it only to people you want to invite. Deleting the conversation immediately makes all participants’ answers and the invitation link unavailable. Question pages do not load ads, analytics, or third-party customer support scripts. Creation and answer endpoints limit request frequency by account. Expired rate-limit records are cleaned up during subsequent requests.
